item.title: Protests in Europe: Fact-checking viral videos amid claims of 'chaos'
item.description: As young people protest poor school conditions and the rising cost of living across Europe, misleading videos are spreading online. item.description: Napoleon Bonaparte and Bernardo O'Higgins: two 19th-century military leaders renowned to this day in their native countries of France and Chile.
